subject: Geography
description: Continents, landlocked countries, borders — exam recognition set

questions.stem: The LARGEST continent by AREA is:
questions.explanation: Order by area: Asia (~44 million km²) > Africa (~30) > North America (~24) > South America (~17) > Antarctica (~14) > Europe (~10) > Australia (~9). Also, Asia has the LARGEST POPULATION (~60% of world total).
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: The country with the LARGEST AREA in the world is:
questions.explanation: Russia (~17.1 million km²) — the world's largest country by area, spanning 11 time zones. Canada (2nd, ~10 million km²). USA + China are very close (both ~9.8 million km²). India — 7th largest.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: Which of these is a LANDLOCKED country?
questions.explanation: Nepal — bordered by India (S) and China (N) only, no sea access. Bhutan is also landlocked. Bangladesh, Myanmar have Bay of Bengal coastline. Sri Lanka is an island. World's only two DOUBLY-landlocked countries: Liechtenstein, Uzbekistan.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: The RING OF FIRE — with ~75% of world's active volcanoes — circles the:
questions.explanation: Ring of Fire — horseshoe-shaped zone around the Pacific Ocean basin. Contains ~75% of active volcanoes + ~90% of major earthquakes. Passes through Japan, Philippines, Indonesia, New Zealand, California, Chile. Caused by tectonic plate subduction.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: Match the COUNTRY with its CONTINENT. A. Egypt.  B. Argentina.  C. Japan.  D. Norway. List-II: 1. Africa.  2. South America.  3. Asia.  4. Europe.
questions.explanation: Egypt — spans both Africa (Sinai is Asia but most of country is Africa); commonly Africa. Argentina — South America. Japan — Asia (East). Norway — Europe (Scandinavia).
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: The THAR DESERT straddles the border of India and:
questions.explanation: Thar (Great Indian Desert) — covers parts of Rajasthan (India) and Sindh (Pakistan). ~200,000 sq km. One of the world's most populous deserts. India-Pakistan border runs through it at points.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: The country that is separated from India by the GULF OF MANNAR is:
questions.explanation: Gulf of Mannar and Palk Strait separate Tamil Nadu from Sri Lanka. Adam's Bridge (Ram Setu) — chain of shoals between Rameswaram and Mannar Island. Closest point: ~30 km.
